first_60000.source_referent: narrow sky-ordered prefix, ill-conditioned, not representative all-sky VSH

all_sky_uniform_row_stride_60000.source_referent: a uniformly spaced set of original FITS catalogue rows covering sky; not cosmological resampling

causal_diagnosis: Source original FITS is sky sorted; first 60000 rows have large parameter-degeneracy condition. F sums agree at approx 6e-15 in both cases, but linear-solve coefficient error is condition-amplified in narrow sky. Do not relax coefficient accuracy claim or infer an implementation fault; compare at fixed accepted source footprint and monitor condition.
resolution: C8 source-equivalent performance and coefficient parity performed on full-sky row-stratified 58750 quality sources. Retain original C1 first-prefix baseline separately. Later source-selected science fit must use its own exact geometry and covariance.
accuracy_claim: Rel F/score/chi2 <2e-11 on original source; beta coefficient parity <2e-11 on representative fullsky well-conditioned source; no guarantee for adversarial ill-conditioned n-prefix without extended-precision solve.
